# error-tracker
> Error capture and grouping with rate limiting and breadcrumb tracking

Error capture with automatic grouping, rate limiting, and breadcrumb history. Identical logical errors (same message + normalized stack frame) are grouped together regardless of where they occur. ```typescript import { ErrorTracker, ConsoleTransport } from 'error-tracker';

## API
- `Transport`
- `ConsoleTransport`
- `InMemoryTransport`
- `CapturedEvent`
- `ErrorTracker`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/Ruzylo-cloud.
